name: Detection
source:
Main character is a detective who mostly does cheating investigations and inquiries of malfunctioning office workers. One day he gets an unusual request that he solves in just one day. But that was just beginning of this case ...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名侦探，主要负责调查作弊行为和询问不正常的办公室职员。有一天，他收到一个不寻常的请求，他只用了一天就解决了。但这只是案件的开始……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-september-2001-eve-fatal.html]vndbreview[/url]]
